meta.description: Required and recommended documents per pipeline. Used for evidence gap detection — the engine compares uploaded documents against the required list and flags missing items.
meta.disclaimer: Document requirements vary by jurisdiction and case facts. This list covers the most commonly needed evidence. Consult legal aid for case-specific requirements.

documents.label: Incident log / timeline of abuse
documents.notes: Dated entries describing each incident. Include who, what, when, where. Photos of injuries with timestamps.

documents.label: Photos of injuries or property damage
documents.notes: Timestamped photos. Include ruler or object for scale. Multiple angles.

documents.label: Police reports
documents.notes: All police reports from DV incidents. Request copies from the department if not provided.

documents.label: Medical records documenting injuries
documents.notes: ER visits, doctor notes, mental health records. Request directly from provider.

documents.label: Protective/restraining order (if filed)
documents.notes: Copy of TRO, permanent order, or any modifications.

documents.label: Threatening texts, emails, voicemails
documents.notes: Screenshots with metadata visible (date, sender). Do not edit or crop.

documents.label: Witness statements or declarations
documents.notes: Signed statements from witnesses, neighbors, family, or DV advocates.

documents.label: Safety plan documentation
documents.notes: From DV shelter or advocate. Documents the safety planning process.

documents.label: Financial records showing economic abuse
documents.notes: Bank statements, credit cards, evidence of financial control or coercion.

documents.label: Lease or rental agreement
documents.notes: Full lease including all addenda, amendments, and house rules.

documents.label: Written notice to landlord (repair requests)
documents.notes: Dated written requests for repairs. Keep copies of all correspondence.

documents.label: Photos/videos of housing conditions
documents.notes: Timestamped photos of habitability issues: mold, pests, broken fixtures, water damage.

documents.label: Eviction notice / pay-or-vacate notice
documents.notes: The original notice served. Note date received and method of service.

documents.label: Rent payment receipts / bank records
documents.notes: Proof of all rent payments. Bank statements, canceled checks, money order receipts.

documents.label: Code enforcement inspection reports
documents.notes: Reports from city/county code enforcement or health department inspections.

documents.label: All landlord communications
documents.notes: Texts, emails, letters from landlord. Include dates and context.

documents.label: Security deposit receipt and move-out documentation
documents.notes: Original deposit receipt, move-in/move-out inspection forms, deduction itemization.

documents.label: Neighbor or witness statements
documents.notes: Statements from neighbors about conditions, harassment, or retaliation.

documents.label: Insurance denial letter / EOB
documents.notes: The original denial letter with reason codes. Explanation of Benefits (EOB) if applicable.

documents.label: Insurance policy / plan documents
documents.notes: Full policy, Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC), Evidence of Coverage (EOC).

documents.label: Original claim submission
documents.notes: Copy of the claim as submitted. Include all supporting documentation sent.

documents.label: Medical records supporting claim
documents.notes: Doctor's notes, test results, treatment plans justifying medical necessity.

documents.label: Letter of medical necessity from treating physician
documents.notes: Physician's letter explaining why the treatment/service is medically necessary.

documents.label: Internal appeal letters and responses
documents.notes: All appeal correspondence. Track dates carefully for external review deadlines.

documents.label: Prior authorization documentation
documents.notes: Prior auth requests, approvals, or denials. Evidence that PA was obtained if required.

documents.label: All insurer communications
documents.notes: Call logs with dates/times/rep names, emails, letters. Document every contact.

documents.label: Medical billing records
documents.notes: Itemized bills, CPT/ICD codes, provider billing statements.

documents.label: Pay stubs / wage statements
documents.notes: All available pay stubs. Note discrepancies in hours, rate, overtime, deductions.

documents.label: Time records / clock-in logs
documents.notes: Personal time log, employer timesheets, clock-in/out records, GPS data.

documents.label: Employment contract / offer letter
documents.notes: Written agreement, offer letter, or any document stating pay rate and terms.

documents.label: Work schedules
documents.notes: Posted schedules, shift assignments, evidence of hours actually worked vs. scheduled.

documents.label: Employer communications about pay/hours
documents.notes: Texts, emails, memos about pay changes, overtime policy, or scheduling.

documents.label: Bank statements showing deposits
documents.notes: Direct deposit records corroborating pay amounts and dates.

documents.label: Coworker statements / declarations
documents.notes: Statements from coworkers about shared conditions, off-the-clock work, or missing breaks.

documents.label: Employee handbook / company policies
documents.notes: Company policies on overtime, breaks, pay periods, deductions.

documents.label: Court order for removal / shelter care order
documents.notes: The original removal order. Note whether emergency or planned removal.

documents.label: Case plan / service plan
documents.notes: The agency's case plan with required services, visitation schedule, and benchmarks.

documents.label: Visitation logs and records
documents.notes: All visitation records. Note any denied or cancelled visits with reasons.

documents.label: Service completion certificates
documents.notes: Proof of completed services: parenting classes, counseling, substance abuse treatment, etc.

documents.label: Caseworker reports / court reports
documents.notes: All reports filed with the court. Review for accuracy and challenge errors.

documents.label: ICWA eligibility documentation
documents.notes: Tribal enrollment, ancestry documentation, ICWA notice compliance. Critical for AI/AN families.

documents.label: Child's medical and educational records
documents.notes: Health records, school records, IEPs, therapy notes.

documents.label: All agency communications
documents.notes: Emails, letters, texts from caseworkers. Document all contacts with dates.

documents.label: Character references / support letters
documents.notes: Letters from family, community members, employers, clergy supporting reunification.

documents.label: Debt validation notice
documents.notes: The initial notice from the collector. Must include amount, creditor name, and dispute rights.

documents.label: Original credit agreement / contract
documents.notes: The original agreement creating the debt. Request from collector if not available.

documents.label: Call logs documenting collector contacts
documents.notes: Date, time, caller ID, what was said. Note harassment, threats, or calls to third parties.

documents.label: All collection letters received
documents.notes: Keep all letters. Note any false statements, threats, or missing disclosures.

documents.label: Written dispute letter (copy)
documents.notes: Copy of your dispute letter sent within 30 days. Keep proof of mailing (certified mail receipt).

documents.label: Payment history / account statements
documents.notes: All payments made. Bank statements showing payments. Evidence of last payment date for SOL.

documents.label: Credit reports showing the debt
documents.notes: Pull from all 3 bureaus. Note any inaccurate reporting for FCRA claims.

documents.label: Guardianship order / letters of guardianship
documents.notes: The court order establishing guardianship. Note scope of authority granted.

documents.label: Guardian's annual reports / accountings
documents.notes: All annual reports filed with the court. Review for accuracy and completeness.

documents.label: Ward's financial records
documents.notes: Bank statements, investment accounts, property records. Compare against guardian's accountings.

documents.label: Ward's medical records
documents.notes: Medical records, care plans, medication logs. Evidence of neglect or inappropriate treatment.

documents.label: Visitor logs / access records
documents.notes: Records of who visited the ward. Note any isolation or denied access to family.

documents.label: Communications with guardian
documents.notes: All correspondence. Note any refusal to communicate or provide information.

documents.label: Independent capacity evaluation
documents.notes: Independent evaluation of ward's capacity. May support restoration of rights.

documents.label: Incident documentation / abuse log
documents.notes: Dated entries describing each incident of abuse, neglect, or exploitation.

documents.label: Photos of injuries, conditions, or environment
documents.notes: Timestamped photos of injuries, living conditions, or facility conditions.

documents.label: Medical records documenting injuries/neglect
documents.notes: ER visits, doctor notes, weight records, medication logs, bedsore documentation.

documents.label: Financial records (for financial exploitation)
documents.notes: Bank statements, POA documents, property transfers, unusual withdrawals.

documents.label: Facility records / care plans
documents.notes: Care plans, staffing records, incident reports, inspection results.

documents.label: APS investigation reports
documents.notes: Reports from Adult Protective Services investigations.

documents.label: Witness statements from staff, family, visitors
documents.notes: Statements from anyone who observed abuse, neglect, or exploitation.

documents.label: Power of attorney / advance directives
documents.notes: POA documents, healthcare directives, POLST. Verify who has legal authority.

documents.label: Current custody/visitation order
documents.notes: The most recent court order governing custody and visitation.

documents.label: Parenting plan
documents.notes: The court-approved parenting plan with schedules, decision-making authority.

documents.label: Log of custody order violations
documents.notes: Dated entries documenting each violation: denied visitation, late returns, no-shows.

documents.label: Co-parent communications
documents.notes: Texts, emails, app messages (OurFamilyWizard, TalkingParents). Do not edit.

documents.label: Child's school and medical records
documents.notes: School records, attendance, grades, medical records, therapy notes.

documents.label: Witness declarations
documents.notes: Statements from teachers, therapists, family members, or others with relevant observations.

documents.label: Financial records (for support issues)
documents.notes: Income records, tax returns, child support payment records.

documents.label: Guardian ad litem / custody evaluator report
documents.notes: GAL or custody evaluator reports. Review for accuracy and challenge errors.
